VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Ladies and gentlemen,
Anthropic is going IPO and it is by far the most controversial IPO in the market!!
On one hand, Anthropic looks like the fastest-growing company in history. Its revenue grew by 1,200% in the past year, it's already profitable on an adjusted operating basis, and today it stands at a $81 billion run rate!! So to the bulls, it looks like the greatest cash machine in the making!!
But on the other hand, the headlines say Anthropic lost 104 billion dollars, it has signed 900 billion dollars of compute commitments which is more than 10 times its revenue and Anthropic is nothing but an overrated AI company!!
So the bears are calling it a disaster in the making!!!
So either Anthropic is a money-making machine, or it's a time bomb that could blow up the economy like 2008!!!
So we dug into Anthropic's 400-page S-1 filing to understand:
What exactly is Anthropic's business model?
Why has it signed 900 billion dollars of contracts when it's still incurring losses?
If it lost 104 billion dollars in nine months, how does it plan to become profitable?
And what are the hidden dangers that you need to be aware of?
